scope: Canton Zurich substantive technical product, R&D and engineering organisations. No investors, generic advocacy, recruitment or CLIMADA.
completion: Finite inventory triage complete: every input row and saved evidence file has an explicit disposition. needs-evidence is a concrete hold, not a verified exclusion. This is not a claim of exhaustive coverage of all organisations in canton Zurich.

definitions.duplicates: Existing current-snapshot entity or repeated inventory candidate. canonicalCandidateId distinguishes within-inventory repetitions.
definitions.outside: Company-published contact/operating address outside canton Zurich and no verified local office in this review.
definitions.ineligible: Explicitly excluded entity or demonstrated activity outside the requested technical scope.
definitions.needs-evidence: Specific unresolved identity, local address, technical activity or retrieval requirement; not a claim that the company is ineligible.
definitions.highconfidence: Company-published technical activity and exact local address verified in saved evidence; absent from current registry.

limitations: Saved company pages are the evidence baseline; no extra bulk crawling or production writes were performed.
A site fetch failure or a changed/parked domain is never treated as proof of dissolution.
Outside refers to evidenced location, not an exhaustive proof that the company has no Zurich branch.
Exact company-published addresses are not geocoded or independently validated against the postal register.
Socials and logos are exact official-page references but remain candidates requiring identity/rendering review before import.
